name: The Ouroboros Express
source:
A majestic train rolls in from the impossible, roiling fog. A charismatic train conductor steps out and welcomes you on.

Are the other passengers just some eccentric rich people, or could there be something more? And why do you get the feeling that the conductor is hiding something? 

There's only one way to find out. All aboard...


Vivienne Sanssouci is a daring journalist who has been tasked to review the Ourobouros Express for the outlet she works for.

She quickly notices that this is not your regular train—and a devastating secret changes her life forever, and that of the other passengers… 

[From [url=https://smallloanstudio.itch.io/the-ouroboros-express]itch.io[/url]]
